description: Aufgaben: Job Description As a Scrum Master Consultant, you will support agile delivery within a complex telecommunications environment focused on Java application development. You will help establish effective Scrum practices, improve collaboration, create transparency around delivery progress, and support teams in overcoming technical, organizational, and cross-functional obstacles. Working in an enterprise setting, you will contribute an independent consulting perspective and provide practical recommendations that strengthen delivery effectiveness. You will be expected to understand the realities of complex software development, including dependencies across teams, vendors, infrastructure components, and OSS/BSS systems. Your structured and solution-oriented approach will help teams remain focused on value delivery, manage risks proactively, and continuously improve their ways of working. You will advise development teams, product stakeholders, and other project participants on Agile and Scrum best practices. You will identify, assess, and communicate technical and organizational impediments affecting delivery. You will recommend mitigation measures for missing system or application access, infrastructure concerns, release blockers, deployment issues, and test data or test environment limitations. You will identify dependencies involving other teams, vendors, and OSS/BSS systems and recommend suitable approaches for managing them. You will provide expert input on delivery optimization, risk management, and continuous improvement opportunities. You will create visibility around progress, blockers, dependencies, and delivery risks. You will facilitate constructive collaboration in an intercultural and complex enterprise environment. You will support teams in becoming more self-organized, structured, transparent, and delivery-focused. You should be confident working with intercultural development teams and navigating complex enterprise or telecommunications environments. A proactive, solution-oriented, and organized mindset is essential, as is the ability to maintain a clear focus on delivery while supporting continuous improvement. The role is suited to a professional with approximately three to five years of relevant experience in Scrum Master or agile consulting assignments. You will bring approximately three to five years of relevant experience as a Scrum Master, Agile Coach, or agile consultant. You will demonstrate experience in Scrum Master consulting engagements within enterprise software development environments. You will have experience working with intercultural development teams and diverse stakeholder groups. You will bring experience from telecommunications, complex enterprise, or similarly demanding technology environments. You will have strong practical knowledge of Agile and Scrum methodologies and their application in real delivery situations. You will be able to assess technical and organizational impediments and recommend appropriate mitigation measures. You will demonstrate excellent communication, stakeholder engagement, facilitation, and conflict-resolution skills. You will be familiar with Jira and Confluence and understand how to use them to support transparency and collaboration. You will be proactive, solution-oriented, self-organized, and comfortable working independently. You will work in a structured, delivery-focused manner and remain effective in complex environments. You will ideally hold a Scrum Master certification such as PSM, CSM, or an equivalent qualification. You will ideally have experience with ServiceNow platforms. description: What's the project's context? Copilot for Logistics is a strategic initiative to identify, assess and prepare AI-supported use cases for administrative activities in warehouse, production and end-to-end logistics processes. The project connects logistics business requirements with SAP-based process knowledge, other systems knowledge and suitable AI capabilities, applications and agent-based solutions, with the objective of creating implementable concepts and a scalable roadmap. Description We are seeking a Senior Functional Consultant – Logistics, SAP and AI to support the development of AI-driven solutions for logistics and SAP-based processes. Mandatory skills: • Several years of functional consulting experience in logistics, warehouse, production logistics, transportation or supply-chain processes • Strong SAP process knowledge, ideally in SAP S/4HANA and one or more logistics components such as EWM, WM, TM, MM, PP or PP/DS • Proven ability to structure business requirements, facilitate stakeholder workshops and translate operational pain points into solution concepts and prioritized use cases • Practical AI experience, including evaluation or implementation of generative AI, copilots, AI agents, natural-language interfaces or intelligent process automation • Ability to bridge business, SAP application, non SAP applications and AI/IT architecture perspectives and communicate effectively with process experts, product teams and architects • Fluent business English (+ German if possible) and strong documentation and presentation skills Optional skills: • Experience with Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, Azure AI, SAP Business AI or other enterprise AI platforms and applications • Knowledge of agent orchestration, MCP, semantic layers, knowledge management, natural-language-to-SQL, identity concepts such as Microsoft Entra ID, and AI testing/observability • Experience with process mining, design thinking, value assessment, business-case preparation or agile product discovery • Bosch logistics, manufacturing or comparable global-enterprise experience; German language skills are an advantage Support the Copilot for Logistics initiative by identifying and shaping high-value AI use cases for logistics, translating logistics and SAP process needs into implementable functional concepts, and guiding the project from discovery through prioritization, validation and implementation preparation. Main task/activity Support the Copilot for Logistics initiative by identifying and shaping high-value AI use cases for logistics, translating logistics and SAP process needs into implementable functional concepts, and guiding the project from discovery through prioritization, validation and implementation preparation. Other tasks and activities • Analyze administrative and decision-support activities in warehouse, production and transportation processes and identify relevant inefficiencies, user needs and automation potential • Plan and facilitate interviews and workshops with logistics process owners, key users, SAP experts, product teams and IT architects • Document as-is processes, pain points, business requirements, user journeys and target outcomes in a structured and traceable form • Develop and refine AI use cases, including user value, functional scope, required data and knowledge, SAP integration points, risks, dependencies and measurable success criteria • Assess solution options across Microsoft Copilot technologies, SAP capabilities, AI agents and other enterprise AI applications, and recommend fit-for-purpose approaches • Prioritize use cases according to business value, feasibility, data readiness, scalability, implementation effort and compliance constraints • Create functional concepts, epics or user stories, acceptance criteria, prototype/PoC scopes and a phased implementation roadmap • Support alignment with AI platform, architecture, security, identity, data and governance stakeholders and prepare decision material for management and funding discussions • Transfer findings from existing proofs of concept and related initiatives into the overall study while keeping the project focus independent of individual PoCs
title: Copilot for Logistics - Functional Consulting and AI Use Case Enablement

A high degree of ownership, reliability and self-management, with the ability to move opportunities forward independently. An entrepreneurial mindset and the willingness to help build a business in close collaboration with its founders. Willingness and ability to travel regularly to customer meetings and industry events. This is central to the role. Additional experience that would be valuable An established network in the German renewable energy sector, especially among wind asset owners and operators in northern Germany. Experience in consultative B2B sales, business development or customer-facing advisory work. Experience selling, implementing or using software for renewable energy asset and portfolio management. description: Hello, We are currently looking for an experienced Senior Data Architect & Data Modeler for a highly interesting project within an international Life Sciences / Diagnostics environment . The key challenge is to transform a currently fragmented scientific data landscape into a structured, connected and harmonized data ecosystem . We therefore need someone who is not only able to further develop an existing architecture, but who has proven experience building data structures and target architectures from the ground up . Main Responsibilities Analyze the existing scientific and operational data landscape across different teams, systems and applications. Map and assess data sources, data flows, APIs, interfaces, repositories and existing data silos . Identify inconsistencies, integration gaps and opportunities for harmonization. Define and establish a scalable target data architecture connecting heterogeneous data sources and domains. Design harmonized and context-rich data models across operational, scientific and analytical data. Structure core scientific entities such as Experiment, Sample, Instrument and Instrument Raw Data into reusable Data Products. Establish relationships and dependencies between different data domains and entities. Define semantic layers, metadata structures, controlled vocabularies and common taxonomies . Establish concepts for Data Governance, Data Ownership, Metadata Management, Data Quality and Data Lineage . Support the integration, migration and standardization of legacy and vendor-specific data sources. Enable reliable data consumption for Data Science, Advanced Analytics and AI use cases . Own architectural deliverables from initial discovery and target architecture through data modeling and implementation guidance. Key Requirements 8+ years of experience in Data Architecture, Data Modeling, Enterprise Data Management or comparable senior data roles. Proven experience designing and establishing complex data architectures from scratch . Strong track record integrating and harmonizing multiple heterogeneous data sources and legacy systems . Ideally previous experience within Life Sciences, Pharma, Biotech, Diagnostics, MedTech or advanced R&D environments . Strong hands-on expertise in Data Modeling and modern data architectures. Strong knowledge of Snowflake and AWS . Experience with Data Products and Data Mesh concepts. Knowledge of modeling methodologies such as Dimensional Modeling / Kimball and Data Vault 2.0 . Strong understanding of Data Governance, Metadata Management and Data Lineage . Ability to translate complex business and scientific requirements into scalable technical data structures. Strong stakeholder management skills and confidence working across Business, R&D, Data Science, Engineering and IT . Ability to take technical/architectural ownership rather than purely executing predefined specifications. Highly Relevant / Strong Advantage Experience with the following would be particularly valuable: FAIR Data Principles Semantic Data Modeling Ontologies and Taxonomies Knowledge Graphs Scientific / Laboratory Data LIMS / ELN environments Instrument-generated data Laboratory instruments such as LC/MS, HPLC or Plate Readers Scientific Data Standards Allotrope Framework , particularly AFO, ASM, ADM and ADF What is particularly important This is not a classic Data Engineer or purely Cloud Architect position . We are particularly interested in candidates who can demonstrate situations where they entered a fragmented or historically grown data environment and: understood and mapped the existing landscape, identified data and integration gaps, defined the target architecture, established harmonized data models and governance, connected different data sources and domains, and created a scalable foundation for Analytics and AI. German language skills are preferable , while strong English communication skills are essential.

description: Freelance Product Marketing Manager (all genders) u.a. Curriculum & Sales Enablement Remote · langfristige Zusammenarbeit möglich · Deutsch (Pflicht), Englisch (sehr gut) Worum geht’s? Im Januar launcht StackFuel/Multiverse neue KI-Trainingsprogramme für Menschen, die sich beruflich neu aufstellen wollen: Arbeitsuchende mit Anspruch auf einen Bildungsgutschein sowie Privatpersonen. Für sie ist ein Curriculum mehr als eine Kursübersicht. Es ist die Entscheidungsgrundlage für einen großen Karriereschritt. Du sorgst dafür, dass diese Entscheidung leicht fällt. Du übersetzt die fachlichen Inhalte unseres Learning Teams in klare Curricula, die die Zielgruppe wirklich ansprechen: mit verständlichen Lernzielen, einer logischen Modulstruktur und Texten, die Mehrwert und Perspektive vermitteln. Daraus entsteht außerdem das Messaging-Fundament für unsere Website. Mehr als ein Projekt: Wir suchen allgemein Freelance Product Marketing Manager:innen. Der KI-Launch im Januar ist der konkrete Einstieg, aber wir können uns generell auch eine längere Zusammenarbeit mit weiteren Launches und Projekten vorstellen. Warum das spannend ist Echter Impact: Aus deinen Curricula werden Programme, die Menschen beruflich weiterbringen. Kurze Wege: Du arbeitest direkt mit Product Marketing, Learning, Sales und Growth. Relevantes Thema: KI-Weiterbildung verändert gerade den Arbeitsmarkt. Klarer Fokus: Die Inhalte liefert das Learning Team, das Design übernimmt unsere Designerin. Du konzentrierst dich auf Konzept und Text. Zeitplan Die heiße Phase läuft von Ende November bis Mitte Dezember, der Go-live ist im Januar. Deine Aufgaben Schwerpunkt: Curricula Du passt bestehende Curricula gezielt an die Zielgruppe an. Mindestens die Hälfte konzipierst du textlich komplett neu. Du bringst die Inhalte des Learning Teams in das bestehende Curriculum-Format: Zielgruppenverständnis, Lernziele, Modulstruktur und Texte. Du gleichst Wording, Mehrwerte und Pain Points der Zielgruppe eng mit Learning und Sales ab. Messaging Du entwickelst ein Messaging-Framework für die neuen Programme. Du erstellst Briefings für unser Growth Team, die in Website-Texte und Kampagnen einfließen. Optional, als zweiter Schritt nach den Curricula Du unterstützt beim Aufbau von Sales-Enablement-Materialien. Die Formate definieren wir gemeinsam, zum Beispiel Pitch-Unterlagen, Beratungsleitfäden oder FAQs. Je nach Zusammenarbeit können weitere Product-Marketing-Aufgaben dazukommen. Nicht Teil der Aufgabe: Inhaltsentwicklung (Learning Team) und Design (unsere Designerin). Mit wem du arbeitest Product Marketing: Steuerung und deine erste Ansprechperson Learning Team: liefert die Inhalte Sales: Zielgruppen-Insights, Wording und Mehrwerte Growth Marketing: übernimmt Messaging und Briefings Design: setzt die Curricula visuell um Das bringst du mit Muss Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Product Marketing, idealerweise im Bildungs-, EdTech- oder B2C-Umfeld Gutes Verständnis von KI- und Data-Themen, sodass du Fachinhalte sicher in Zielgruppen-Sprache übersetzen kannst Starke konzeptionelle und redaktionelle Fähigkeiten auf Deutsch Eine selbstständige Arbeitsweise und Erfahrung in der Abstimmung mit mehreren Stakeholdern Wünschenswert Kenntnis des Weiterbildungsmarkts, insbesondere im Umfeld von Bildungsgutschein, Arbeitsagentur, Jobcenter und AZAV-Maßnahmen Erfahrung in Instructional Design oder Curriculum-Entwicklung Sehr gute Englischkenntnisse Praxis im Einsatz von KI-Tools im Arbeitsalltag Bewerbung Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und Arbeitsproben, zum Beispiel Curricula, Messaging-Frameworks oder Enablement-Materialien. Gib außerdem an, mit welchem konkreten Zeitaufwand du das oben beschriebene Projekt umsetzen würdest (z. B. Stunden pro Woche und geplanter Zeitraum).

description: Location: Remote (100%) We are seeking a Senior IT Architect / Analyst to research, design, and evaluate methods for building high-quality knowledge graphs (KGs) and using them in AI applications — especially LLM and agent-based systems. You will work at the intersection of semantic modeling, information extraction, graph analytics, and AI evaluation: defining what "good" graph quality means, benchmarking the methods that produce graphs, and designing reasoning workflows that stay grounded in graph evidence. This is a research-oriented architecture role : you will not only design systems but also establish how their quality is measured, proven, and reproduced. Key responsibilities Knowledge graph quality & measurement Research, design, and evaluate methods for building high-quality knowledge graphs and applying them in AI systems. Define and operationalize graph quality metrics: coverage, consistency, accuracy, provenance, and uncertainty . Develop methods to measure completeness of graphs and detect information gaps. Information extraction & benchmarking Benchmark NER, entity resolution, relation extraction , and LLM-based extraction approaches for turning unstructured data into reliable graphs. Evaluate methods for ontology development, domain modeling, and concept hierarchies . Build benchmarks, baselines, and ablation studies; translate findings into reproducible experiments, evaluation frameworks, and practical recommendations. Graph analytics & reasoning Apply graph theory, statistics, and probabilistic methods to analyze structure, connectivity, communities, and information gaps. Investigate traversal and retrieval strategies (hop limits, edge direction, weights, relevance scoring, pruning). Design multi-step reasoning, critique, and verification workflows grounded in graph evidence. Research link prediction and graph embeddings , keeping inferred knowledge explicitly separate from verified facts. Required qualifications Mathematical foundations Strong grounding in graph theory, linear algebra, probability, statistics, and optimization . Research depth Demonstrated research experience in knowledge graphs, information extraction, ontology learning, semantic modeling, and graph-based machine learning (publications, dissertations, or equivalent applied research a plus). AI-native experimentation Practical ability to use LLMs and agent workflows to accelerate research, with a rigorous habit of validating results through evidence and measurement. Data analysis & programming Advanced Python ; SQL ; graph query languages (e.g., SPARQL, Cypher); reproducible research tooling. Evaluation judgment Rigorous experimental design: error analysis, uncertainty estimation, sensitivity analysis, ablation studies , and reproducible benchmarking. Nice to have Experience with enterprise knowledge graphs, RDF/OWL/SHACL/SKOS, and graph databases (Neo4j, ArangoDB, Virtuoso, GraphDB). Experience evaluating or building GraphRAG / neuro-symbolic systems that ground LLM output in structured knowledge. Familiarity with regulated or enterprise environments and provenance/audit requirements. PhD or research-track background in semantic web, NLP, or graph ML.

description: Project Goal: Design and engineer a custom large-diameter winding core, a roll support system on a metal pallet, and a structural reinforcement of an existing oven for heat treatment of plastic film rolls at approximately 150 °C. The project is located in Herbolzheim (Baden-Württemberg, near Freiburg im Breisgau). Background: Nano-coatings are applied to plastic films with a thickness of 25–50 µm and a web width of 1600–1800 mm. Currently, the film is wound on a 6-inch metal core and placed in an oven for long-duration heat treatment at approx. 150 °C. Rolls can weigh several hundred kilograms. Three core problems must be solved: the existing 6-inch core diameter damages the film and must be replaced by a custom core of Ø 400 mm or more; the roll must be loadable into the oven on a pallet using a forklift or stacker; and the oven structure must be reinforced to handle heavy loads it was not originally designed for. Main Tasks: 1) Large-Diameter Core Assembly - Design a core shell with Ø ? 400 mm for 1600–1800 mm web width - End flanges bored in the center to fit a 6-inch tube compatible with the existing winding/unwinding line - Flanges with openings (open/perforated design) to allow hot air to flow through the core during heat treatment - Requirements to be met: torque transmission for winding/unwinding, roundness and concentricity, low run-out and deflection under load, smooth surface without edges or weld marks that could damage the film, long-term suitability at 150 °C including consideration of thermal expansion, no particle or contamination risk, weight compatible with the existing line 2) Roll Support and Pallet - Design supports holding the core assembly at both ends (e.g. via the 6-inch tube ends), mounted on a metal pallet - The assembly must fit through the oven door and into the oven interior (approx. 119 × 203 × 219 cm, W × D × H); the roll axis runs along the 203 cm depth, making overall length (core + tube ends + supports) very tight at 1800 mm web width - Loading concept to be proposed for forklift/stacker with pallet inserted lengthwise (e.g. long forks, rails or loading trolley) - Material proposal with cost comparison among galvanized steel, aluminium and stainless steel (cost is a concern) - Total load (core + film + support + pallet): 500–800 kg - Concept for safely transferring the roll from the winding line to the support 3) Oven Reinforcement - Assessment of the existing oven structure - Design of a reinforcement suitable for 500–800 kg including safe loading (e.g. guides/rails), without compromising insulation and hot-air circulation 4) Future Option – To Be Anticipated in the Design - Very slow rotation of the core and film roll around its axis inside the oven (approx. 1 revolution per 4 hours) - Bearings suitable for 150 °C, drive interface, motor possibly positioned outside the oven Expected Deliverables: - Site visit and requirements review - Concept proposal(s) with rough fabrication cost estimate - 3D CAD model and structural calculations (loads, deflection, FEA where needed) - 2D manufacturing drawings, bill of materials and complete manufacturing file (materials, tolerances, welding, surface finish/treatment) - Support in selecting and briefing fabrication shops and comparison of quotes - Ideally: follow-up of fabrication including quality checks and acceptance, and support during on-site installation Requirements: - Mechanical design engineer or technician with experience in special machine construction, ideally in web handling or converting (winding cores, shafts, roll handling) - Experience with steel and aluminium structures, design for high temperatures and material selection - Proficiency in CAD (e.g. SolidWorks, Inventor, Creo) and static calculation/FEA - Languages: English or German; French is a plus Working Model: Design work can be done partly remotely. On-site presence is required for kick-off and measurements, fabrication follow-up and installation. Project location is Herbolzheim, Baden-Württemberg, near Freiburg im Breisgau.
title: Mechanical Design Engineer for Custom Winding Core & Oven Reinforcement – Herbolzheim

Dort wollen wir sichtbar sein – mit den richtigen Inhalten und für die Menschen, die unsere Beratung brauchen. Bechert Rechtsanwälte vertritt seit über 25 Jahren ausschließlich Arbeitnehmer und Betriebsräte. Unsere Mandanten finden uns über arbeitsrecht-berlin.de , betriebsrat-berlin.de und weiteren Websites, auf Deutsch und zunehmend auch auf Englisch. Unsere Seiten laufen auf WordPress, teilweise mit Elementor. Die technische Grundstruktur betreut unsere Agentur, und das soll so bleiben. Was uns fehlt, ist jemand, der dranbleibt: der erkennt, wo wir Sichtbarkeit verschenken, Ideen entwickelt und sie auch selbst umsetzt. Was du bei uns machst Du übernimmst die laufende Betreuung und Weiterentwicklung unserer Websites mit dem Ziel, unsere Sichtbarkeit zu verbessern und mehr qualifizierte Mandatsanfragen zu gewinnen. Am Anfang steht der Blick in die Zahlen: Wie entwickeln sich Rankings, Besucherzahlen und Anfragen? Daraus entwickelst du einen Plan, setzt Prioritäten und machst dich an die Umsetzung – eigenständig in WordPress und Elementor oder gemeinsam mit unserer Agentur. Du optimierst bestehende Seiten, verbesserst interne Verlinkungen und Nutzerführung und entwickelst unsere Angebotsseiten weiter. Wer einen Termin buchen möchte, soll das möglichst einfach können. Auch die Einbindung von Calendly, Zoom und anderen Diensten behältst du im Blick. Zur Aufgabe gehört außerdem unsere Sichtbarkeit außerhalb der eigenen Websites: Google-Unternehmensprofile, Anwaltsverzeichnisse, Bewertungs- und Fachportale, sinnvoller Linkaufbau und zunehmend auch die Auffindbarkeit in KI-gestützten Suchsystemen. Zum Jahreswechsel steht unser Kanzleiumzug an, bei dem sämtliche Standortangaben aktualisiert werden müssen. Du betreust auch unsere englischsprachigen Seiten und unterstützt bei neuen Angebotsseiten und Blogartikeln. Wenn du selbst gerne schreibst, umso besser. Der Schwerpunkt liegt aber auf der technischen und strategischen Weiterentwicklung, nicht auf der Texterstellung. Die juristische Prüfung übernehmen wir. Was funktioniert, was nicht und was als Nächstes ansteht, besprichst du regelmäßig mit uns – verständlich und ohne Fachchinesisch. Entscheidend ist für uns nicht allein die Reichweite, sondern wie viele qualifizierte Mandatsanfragen und Terminbuchungen daraus entstehen. Was du mitbringst Du hast bereits Websites eigenständig betreut und kannst zeigen, was sich durch deine Arbeit verbessert hat – idealerweise anhand konkreter Zahlen. WordPress und Elementor beherrschst du sicher, auch bei individuell gestalteten Seiten. Technisches SEO, Onpage-Optimierung, Keyword-Recherche und Google Search Console gehören zu deinem Handwerk. Mit lokalem SEO, Verzeichnispflege und Linkaufbau kennst du dich ebenfalls aus. Du sprichst sehr gut Deutsch und gut Englisch, verstehst die Perspektive der Website-Besucher und hast ein Gespür dafür, was aus einem Besuch eine Anfrage macht. Vor allem arbeitest du selbstständig, erkennst Probleme, setzt Prioritäten und bringst eigene Vorschläge ein. Erfahrung mit Kanzleien oder anderen beratungsintensiven Dienstleistungen ist willkommen, aber keine Voraussetzung. Wie wir zusammenarbeiten Wir suchen eine längerfristige Zusammenarbeit mit einem Umfang von ungefähr 20 Stunden pro Woche. Zunächst auf freiberuflicher Basis, mit der Möglichkeit einer späteren Festanstellung, wenn es für beide Seiten passt. Du organisierst deine Arbeit weitgehend selbstständig und arbeitest überwiegend remote. Gerade zu Beginn möchten wir uns aber regelmäßig persönlich austauschen, ab Januar 2027 in unserer neuen Kanzlei direkt gegenüber dem Arbeitsgericht Berlin. Du arbeitest unmittelbar mit den Anwälten zusammen, die auch die Entscheidungen treffen. Wir haben kurze Wege, sind offen für neue Ideen und möchten jemanden, der unsere Online-Präsenz wirklich mitgestaltet. Ein kurzfristiger Einstieg ist möglich. Interesse? Dann schreib uns an ***** . Erzähl uns kurz, wer du bist, und zeig uns ein oder zwei Projekte, auf die du stolz bist. Besonders interessiert uns, welche Verbesserungen du dort erreichen konntest. Außerdem freuen wir uns über Angaben zu deiner Erfahrung mit WordPress und Elementor, deinem möglichen Starttermin, deiner Verfügbarkeit, deinem Stundensatz und dazu, wie oft du zu Beginn in Berlin vor Ort sein könntest.

Erstellung und Pflege von technischer Dokumentation, funktionalen Spezifikationen und Feature-Beschreibungen für neue Digital-Solution-Releases. 5. SAP-Fachkompetenz: Ausgewogene funktionale Expertise in beiden Kerndisziplinen: SAP EWM: Solide Erfahrung mit Workflows im Extended Warehouse Management und mit Lagermigrationen.
